meta.notes: All weights in metric tonnes unless stated. Regulations apply to vehicles of 3.5 t permissible weight or above. A tolerance of 5% is allowed on permissible axle load limits (Reg. 8(2)).

mccVehicleClasses.label: Saloon Cars & Taxis
mccVehicleClasses.description: Passenger saloon cars, station wagons and taxi cars.

mccVehicleClasses.label: Light Goods, Vans, Pickups & 4WD
mccVehicleClasses.description: Light goods vehicles, vans, pickups and four-wheel-drive utility vehicles.

mccVehicleClasses.label: Small Buses, Minibuses & Matatus
mccVehicleClasses.description: Small buses, 14-seat minibuses and matatus (shared taxis).

mccVehicleClasses.label: Medium Buses (Coasters)
mccVehicleClasses.description: Medium buses, typically 25–35 seat coaster-type vehicles.

mccVehicleClasses.label: Light Single Unit Trucks (Dynas & Tractors)
mccVehicleClasses.description: Light single-unit trucks under ~7 t (e.g. Dyna type) and agricultural tractors.

mccVehicleClasses.label: Medium/Large Single Unit Trucks (2–4 axles, 7+ t)
mccVehicleClasses.description: Rigid single-unit trucks of 7 t and above with 2 to 4 axles, including tippers and box trucks.

mccVehicleClasses.label: Truck Trailers & Semi-Trailers (5+ axles)
mccVehicleClasses.description: Articulated truck-tractor plus semi-trailer, and truck-plus-drawbar-trailer combinations with 5 or more axles (fuel tankers, container haulers).

axleCodeLegend.*: Separates steering unit from drive unit of the power unit
axleCodeLegend.-: Separates power unit from semi-trailer axle group
axleCodeLegend.+: Separates truck from drawbar trailer (front/rear trailer axle groups)

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 2-axle rigid truck
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Single steering axle + single drive axle (dual tyres). Typical GVW limit 18 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 2-axle rigid truck (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric notation equivalent of S*D. Typical GVW limit 18 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 3-axle rigid truck
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Steering axle + tandem drive axle group. Typical GVW limit 26 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 3-axle rigid truck (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of S*DD. Typical GVW limit 26 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 4-axle rigid truck
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Twin-steer tandem steering + tandem drive. Typical GVW limit 34 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 4-axle rigid truck (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of SS*DD. Typical GVW limit 34 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 4-axle rigid (tridem drive)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Steering axle + tridem rear group.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 5-axle rigid (twin steer + tridem)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tandem steering + tridem rear group.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 5-axle rigid (twin steer, single + tandem)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tandem steering + single and tandem rear axles.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 5-axle articulated (1+1 tractor, tridem semi)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: 2-axle tractor + tridem-axle semi-trailer. Typical GVW limit 42–48 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 5-axle articulated (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of S*D-DDD.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (tandem drive, tridem semi)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: 3-axle tractor (tandem drive) + tridem semi-trailer. Max legal combination, GVW limit 56 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of S*DD-DDD. GVW limit 56 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (twin single + drive, tridem semi)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tractor with single second axle + drive axle, tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (numeric twin steer)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Twin-steer tractor + drive axle, tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (numeric, single mid axle)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Steer + single + drive tractor, tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (numeric, mixed tyres)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Steer + dual + single tractor axles, tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (super-single semi)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tandem-drive tractor + tridem semi-trailer on wide-base super single tyres (lower axle limit 22.5 t tridem).

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (super-single semi, single mid axle)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Variant with single-tyre second tractor axle and super-single tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (super-single tractor axle)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tractor with wide-base axle + drive, tridem semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: 6-axle articulated (super-single steer and mid axle)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Wide-base steering and intermediate axles, tridem dual semi-trailer.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: Truck + drawbar trailer (3-axle truck, 3-axle trailer)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Rigid tandem-drive truck towing a drawbar trailer (single front, tandem rear). Typical GVW limit 48–54 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: Truck + drawbar trailer (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of S*DD+D*DD.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: Truck + drawbar trailer (3-axle truck, 4-axle trailer)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Tandem-drive truck + 4-axle drawbar trailer. GVW limit up to 56 t.

weighbridgeConfigurations.label: Truck + 4-axle drawbar trailer (numeric)
weighbridgeConfigurations.description: Numeric equivalent of S*DD+DD*DD. GVW limit up to 56 t.

schedule2AxleConfigurations.title: Schedule 2 — Axle Configuration and Load Limit (Regulation 5)
schedule2AxleConfigurations.note: All weights in tonnes; vehicles have conventional tyres unless marked super single. wheelsPerAxle lists the number of wheels on each axle front-to-rear; axleLimits are the permissible axle-group limits in the same order.

schedule4PermissibleAxleLoads.title: Schedule 4 — Permissible Axle Load Weights (Regulation 9)
schedule4PermissibleAxleLoads.toleranceNote: A tolerance of 5% of the permissible maximum axle load is allowed (Reg. 8(2)).

grossVehicleWeight.rule: Permissible maximum gross vehicle weight is 56 tonnes (Reg. 7), subject to axle spatial distribution per the bridge formula; the gross weight may not exceed the permissible combined axle load weight.

dimensionLimits.title: Regulation 4 — Vehicle Dimensions
dimensionLimits.applicability: Vehicles of 3.5 tonnes permissible weight or above on national roads.

specialLoadClasses.conditions: Rotating/flashing lights; trip notification with the Authority.
One escort vehicle; rotating/flashing lights; trip notification.
Two escort vehicles; rotating/flashing lights; trip notification.
Two escort vehicles; rotating/flashing lights; police escort; trip notification; front and back marking.
Two escort vehicles; rotating/flashing lights; police escort; trip notification; detailed route survey report; front and back marking.

Width above 4.75 m (max 6 m) / length above 54 m: two escort vehicles + two police escort vehicles; route selection trip; traffic cones, fire extinguisher, duplex radio link; prominent front and back marking.

grossWeightFeesUsd.note: Schedule 3 Part I — fees by overload above permissible gross weight (tonnes: USD).

perAxleFeesUsdFirstRows.note: Schedule 3 Part II — per-axle overload fees (USD) for first overload bands (kg: [Steering, Single Drive, Tandem, Tridem]).
